subject: Discovery recap: acceptance gates, POV scope and exec readout request
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@lumidocs.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv@lumidocs.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-24T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery recap: acceptance gates, POV scope and exec readout request

Thanks for the time today — quick recap and next steps so we stay aligned. High level notes from our call: 

- Primary goal: reduce ingestion-to-answer latency for document search and summarization; target median latency < 400ms for front-line agents.
- Success criteria (customer-proposed): 1) average answer relevance >= 0.78 on L1 sample set, 2) latency median < 400ms, 3) false-positive rate for redaction >= 98% on PII checks.
- Data constraints: sample corpus (~10k documents) will be shared in a staging bucket; data residency requirement: US-only.
- Timeline preference: 3–4 week Proof-of-Value (PoV) followed by an executive readout and go/no-go decision.

Proposed next steps from Redwood: 
1) We prepare a short PoV plan (deliverables + acceptance tests) and share by EOD tomorrow.
2) Customer provides sample corpus access and a list of 6 concrete evaluation prompts/test cases by next Tue (2027-08-31).
3) We kick off a 3-week PoV starting Mon 9/6, with an executive readout week of 9/27 — if that works for you we can lock an exec slot.

Questions for you now: 
- Can you confirm the three success criteria above or suggest edits?
- Who will be the sign-off authority for the exec readout (name/title)?
- Any procurement/legal touchpoints we should loop in during the PoV (SOW/NDAs)?

I've cc'd Grace (AE) and Marissa (Solutions) to own logistics and the technical runbook. We'll attach a one-page PoV plan and a checklist in the next message.

Best,

Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Lead
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood-POV-plan.pdf (application/pdf)]
From: Elena Torres <elena@lumidocs.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@lumidocs.com>
Date: 2027-08-24T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: acceptance gates, POV scope and exec readout request

Thanks Hannah — great recap. Confirming the acceptance gates below (slight tweaks inline):

- Relevance target: we can accept >= 0.75 on the first pass, with improvement plan to 0.78 by final readout.
- Latency: median < 450ms acceptable during PoV (production target remains <400ms).
- PII redaction: target 98% as noted.

Constraints/notes:
- We'll provision a staging S3 bucket (US region) and create a service account for Redwood access.
- Legal will need a short SOW for the PoV with liability/NDAs clarified — I will flag to procurement (CC Rajiv).
- Exec sign-off will be me (Head of Customer Success) and our CTO, Marcus Hale (will loop him later).

9/27 for an exec readout looks possible. We prefer afternoons (2–4pm PT). If you can share the PoV checklist and owner matrix, we can confirm resource availability.

Elena
Director of Customer Success, LumiDocs
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@lumidocs.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv@lumidocs.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-25T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: PoV checklist & owner matrix + proposed timeline (attached)

Elena — attached is a concise PoV checklist and owner matrix to map responsibilities. Key bits here: 

- Duration: 3 weeks (kickoff Mon 2027-09-06, final validation week of 2027-09-27).
- Deliverables: 1) daily KPI dashboard (latency, accuracy, tokens) 2) week 2 interim readout 3) final exec readout with decision memo.
- Owners: Redwood tech lead (Marissa Cole) for ingest & model tuning; Grace O'Connor for exec coordination and contract path; Hannah (me) for acceptance gating and rollout plan.
- Acceptance tests: we will run the 6 canonical prompts + 1 adversarial set you provide; pass threshold as agreed on 8/24 reply.

Attachments: POC-checklist.xlsx (owner columns filled), Redwood-POV-plan.pdf (high level runbook). Please review and confirm by 8/31 so we can lock resources.

If 9/27 is still good for an exec slot, Grace will reserve a 2–4pm PT window and share a calendar invite once you confirm. Also note: we will need a short PoV SOW (1–2 pages) for procurement — I can draft and route for signature before the kickoff.

Best,
Hannah
[Attachment: POC-checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Quick internal note to align before we lock the calendar: 

- Marissa: you own ingest + tuning. Please prepare a 30-min interim demo for week 2 (2027-09-13) showing raw vs tuned outputs.
- Grace: please reserve 9/27 2–4pm PT as tentative exec slot; include a 20-min Q&A and a 10-min decision window.
- I'll draft the 1–2 page PoV SOW and route to Rajiv once Elena confirms.

Also: Marissa, flag any infra needs (GPU priority, region access) by EOD Friday (8/27) so we can request capacity.

Thanks — Hannah
From: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@lumidocs.com>

1) We confirm the sample corpus will be available by 8/31 and we'll create the service account with US region restrictions.
2) Procurement asked us to review a short SOW before kickoff; please send the draft. If possible, include a clause for expedited signature (we have an internal deadline for budget approval the week after the exec readout).

We OK the 9/27 2–4pm PT window — Marcus (CTO) will attend. Please send a DocuSign link for the PoV SOW and the Redwood readout agenda.
